question: Should OpenClaw add task-level model metadata to `HEARTBEAT.md`, or should heartbeat task routing remain a whole-turn/plugin routing concern?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but the implementation depends on maintainer intent for public `HEARTBEAT.md` syntax, task batching versus split turns, and how overrides compose with provider auth, fallbacks, and session state.

options.title: Design Shared Routing Contract First
options.body: Keep this issue open and decide a reusable heartbeat or per-turn routing contract before accepting `HEARTBEAT.md`-only syntax.

options.title: Add Heartbeat-Only Metadata
options.body: Implement a narrow `HEARTBEAT.md` task model field with explicit split/group semantics, alias/fallback rules, docs, and compatibility tests.

options.title: Keep Routing Plugin-Owned
options.body: Document whole-turn `before_model_resolve` plugins as the supported routing path and accept that multiple due heartbeat tasks cannot be independently routed today.

recommendation.title: Design Shared Routing Contract First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and decide a reusable heartbeat or per-turn routing contract before accepting `HEARTBEAT.md`-only syntax.
